graphics.name: Weight, the last 30 days Daily readings as unconnected dots, the seven-day average as the solid line, and the goal trajectory dashed inside its corridor. Days with no reading are hatched and are never joined up.
graphics.desc: Daily readings as unconnected dots, the seven-day average as the solid line, and the goal trajectory dashed inside its corridor. Days with no reading are hatched and are never joined up.

graphics.name: Waist, the last 30 days Waist measurements, joined between the readings that exist. A tape measure is used about once a week by one person in one place, so two readings a week apart are two comparable measurements and are drawn joined; nothing between them is invented.
graphics.desc: Waist measurements, joined between the readings that exist. A tape measure is used about once a week by one person in one place, so two readings a week apart are two comparable measurements and are drawn joined; nothing between them is invented.

graphics.name: Weight and waist, the last 30 days Weight above and waist below, on one time axis. Weight carries its seven-day average and the goal trajectory; waist is measured by hand and is drawn as the readings it has. The days the scale went quiet are hatched in both bands.
graphics.desc: Weight above and waist below, on one time axis. Weight carries its seven-day average and the goal trajectory; waist is measured by hand and is drawn as the readings it has. The days the scale went quiet are hatched in both bands.

graphics.name: Steps, the last 30 days One bar per day. A day the phone sent nothing has no bar and is hatched, never a bar of zero.
graphics.desc: One bar per day. A day the phone sent nothing has no bar and is hatched, never a bar of zero.

graphics.name: Sleep, the last 30 nights One bar per night. A night the watch did not record has no bar and is hatched, never a bar of zero.
graphics.desc: One bar per night. A night the watch did not record has no bar and is hatched, never a bar of zero.

graphics.name: Resting heart rate, the last 30 days Resting heart rate, one point per reading, joined only between the readings that exist.
graphics.desc: Resting heart rate, one point per reading, joined only between the readings that exist.
